overview_description.description: Simbi is an online marketplace that runs on talents, services, and skills, not cash, credit, or check. Founded in 2015 and based in San Francisco, Simbi provides a way for freelancers and independent workers to turn their unbooked hours into real economic value. Simbi simultaneously increases the size of the economy while supporting small-scale entrepreneurs to do the flexible work they love.

product.name: Service Exchange Platform
product.description: A platform that allows members to exchange services using a virtual currency called simbi credits. Members can offer or request services from each other.

product.name: Simbi Market
product.description: An online marketplace where members can use simbi credits to purchase items or services offered by other members.

product.name: Skill Quiz
product.description: An online quiz designed to help members identify and list their skills or services they can offer within the community.

product.name: Privacy Policy
product.description: Details the ways in which the user's personal data is collected, used, and protected by Simbi.

product.name: EU Privacy Notice
product.description: Provides additional information on data protection rights for users located in the European Union and related regions.

product.name: Donate to Simbi Community Development
product.description: Allows users to make donations to support Simbi's nonprofit mission, including options for one-time donations, becoming a Simbi Supporter, and donating with cryptocurrency.
